confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are triangulated from several Rome-specific aggregated sources (Numbeo-based cost-of-living pages, Expatistan, 2026 price guides). Several are secondary or undated, so expect roughly +/-20%. Cocktail and wine were set from direct price reports, not from beer; beer assumes a 0.4-0.5 L draught. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of central Rome in July peak season. No booking pages or current listings were consulted, so expect roughly +/-30%. The FX value was taken from a third-party listing (ozfinancehub.com.au) that presents it as the RBA rate for 2026-11-18; rba.gov.au was not opened directly, so verify before use. Euro prices were converted at an approximate working rate, not a verified July 2026 quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city substituted. Food and drink anchors rest on Rome-specific price points; accommodation rests on general knowledge of central Rome July hotel and hostel rates.
